saw_lines: Department store shoppers rarely buy on impulse. They come for a gift or one item they already had in mind.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before the shopper decides the store is worth a click.
Your 10 video and 17 image Google creatives carry no offer we can read, so lead the next batch with a gift offer on the image.
ads_1: Google video and image ads for Galeria, led by seasonal gift angles
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
